title: NIC 2026 solution manifest (solution.yml)
description: automation/CONTRACT.md sections 2 and 10. Every solution folder carries one. Validated by Get-NIC26SolutionManifest.

name.description: Unique kebab-case solution name (also the folder name).

secrets.description: Names (never values) of the Key Vault secrets the solution reads at run time.

names.description: Name catalog: logical key -> naming-standard type and purpose; resolved by New-NIC26ResourceName and passed to IaC as the 'names' input.

solution_root.description: Added by Get-NIC26SolutionManifest; not written in the file.

solution_path.description: Added by Get-NIC26SolutionManifest; not written in the file.

name.description: Canonical snake_case name from the design variables tables.

default.description: Only genuinely safe defaults; never a tenant, subscription or address.

path.description: Optional dot path into the config when the value is nested (e.g. secret_refs.jump_admin_password).

nameSpec.description: Shapes: {type, purpose?, instance?, region?, suffix?} generated; {type: peer, from, to} peering (from/to = catalog keys or literals); {type: nic|osdisk|datadisk|vhd|bmc, parent} derived from a VM/node catalog key; {type: netbios, purpose} computer names; {type, fixed, exempt: true} Azure-fixed names (pdnszone/pdns, fixedsubnet, imgver, tfstate, container, or any type with exempt: true); reserved: true is metadata.

type.description: Registry type abbreviation or alias (required unless fixed + exempt: true; enforced by Get-NIC26SolutionManifest) (rg, vnet, st, kv, peer|vnetpeering|peering, pdnszone|pdns, netbios, role, ...).

purpose.description: Empty or omitted only for lab-wide singletons (law, gal, vdws).

from.description: Peering source: a catalog key (resolved name) or a literal such as hub.

to.description: Peering target: a catalog key or a literal.

parent.description: Catalog key (or literal name) of the VM/node a nic/osdisk/datadisk/vhd/bmc belongs to.

fixed.description: Azure-fixed or externally fixed name passed through unchanged.

name.description: Alias of 'fixed' for exempt types (pdnszone, fixedsubnet, imgver).

exempt.description: Declares the name exempt from the nic26 rule (naming standard 3b).

reserved.description: Metadata: named by this design, created by a later solution. Resolved like any other entry.
